constraints.description: Admit only the actual pinned manifest-prefix path.
Require the target toolchain to be built from source in the declared path.
Require the declared path to satisfy the bounded bootstrap-ancestry policy.
Require the path to use the bounded model's declared auditable bootstrap root policy.

regimes.label: Observed
regimes.description: The factual pinned trace path; this is a reference regime, not an optimization regime.

regimes.label: Free
regimes.description: Admits every path explicitly declared in this finite construction space.

regimes.label: Source-derived
regimes.description: Requires the final GCC target to be built from source but permits a pre-existing binary toolchain.

regimes.label: Bootstrappable
regimes.description: Rejects paths that violate the bounded bootstrap-ancestry policy.

regimes.label: Auditable bootstrap
regimes.description: Adds the bounded model's stricter auditable-root policy to bootstrap ancestry.
